mathematical_prose.derivation: For a finite decimal x=N/10^d, x*10^k=N*10^k/10^d. This is a rightward decimal-place shift by k, padding zeros as necessary. The scale factor is dimensionless; any existing unit is retained. The listed 10/100/1000 are 10^1/10^2/10^3, not arbitrary integers ending in zeros.
4.576=4576/1000; 4576*10=45760; 45760/1000=45.760=45.76. Restoring three fractional places in the integer product is consistent with the overall one-place right shift of 4.576.
4.576*10=45.76; moving the source decimal one place right produces exactly that product.
4576*100=457600; restoring three fractional places gives 457.600=457.6, hence 4.576*100=457.6.

The complete original sentence says one rightward place produces 457.6 from 4.576. One place instead yields 45.76; two places yields 457.6. Contradiction is independent arithmetic, not an answer/key inference. Raw source must remain unchanged; modern resolution is outside this freeze.
0.124124=124124/1000000; multiplying by 10000 yields 124124/100=1241.24. Four rightward places.
3.7=3.70=37/10; (37/10)*100=370. The added trailing zero changes representation, not value; the colon introducing 3.7=3.70 is not an additional multiplier.
0.1/0.01/0.001 are 10^-1/10^-2/10^-3. x*10^-k=x/10^k, a leftward shift by k with leading-zero padding when necessary. Scale factor is dimensionless.
003.7=3.7 in decimal notation, not an octal integer. (37/10)*(1/100)=37/1000=0.037; the literal leading zeros are mathematically harmless and are not silently removed from source.
